status: Frozen before diagnostic-hook preparation; execution requires a later explicit CPU/MAIN grant
worktree_creation: Root prepares these own disposable worktrees at the exact base; runner never changes branches or Git refs. Shipping worktree is read-only.
permissions: Launch requires require_escalated for private Unix sockets; preflight Unix datagram and loopback TCP before Cargo.
witness_contract: Separate from every product input; actual VoiceTiming declaration unchanged at500ms, bus expiry grace50ms. No production topic, schema or source change.
setup_boundary: Immediately after the initial constructor/options block. The same test-only helper moves with that existing block; no product function instrumented.
expiry_condition: The exact retained header identity/payload is unchanged and Bus::latest returns expired=true at real wall time strictly beyond header.at_unix_ms+expires_ms+EXPIRY_GRACE_MS. No fixed completion sleep.
negative_control: After the first actual populate and before first step, wait for that actual VoiceTiming header to expire. For offline-face, apply only when offline_face=true; false stays healthy and its original assertion must pass.
offline_branch_limits: Old delayed false arm fails, so true arm is explicitly unrun. New delayed pass includes both false and true originals. New after-publication-expiry control requires false arm healthy, then fails only true at the original expect.
assertion_invariants: Every original assertion and tail unchanged; logical 10_000_000/12_000_000/12_100_000 values, captured wall, lease200ms bound, input-loss/restart checks, both face outcomes and all product timing unchanged.
source_invariants: Only scratch runtime test hooks; no product-source edits, expiry changes, input republish, hidden exact-case retries or cache reuse without source freshness.
restoration: Save source closures before mutation. In finally restore before WT to exact baseline and after WT to exact shipping two-file candidate; verify whole tracked-source hashes and the untouched shipping worktree. Cargo/build failures and all observations retained.
execution_once: One before compile, two before observations; one after compile, four after observations. No retry of any observed failure. Metadata --list/--ignored inventories are not test execution.
recording: Full raw stdout/stderr/commands/exits; actual artifact hash/file/rustc identity; source hashes before/after every command; exact input/header/payload/control markers; actual terminal row and branch reachability. Production Subscriber::admit remains unobserved; helper snapshots and original results are labeled as such.
unexecuted_normal_gates: After restoration, root schedules original full runtime/package/fmt/strictClippy/workspace gate separately; this control runner must not add runs.
